tools.name: health_check
tools.description: Report whether the server and its database answer.

tools.name: ensure_project
tools.description: Create the project for a repository path if it does not exist, and return it.

human_key.description: Absolute path of the repository's primary checkout.

tools.name: register_agent
tools.description: Register or update an agent identity in a project. Omit name to get a generated adjective+noun name; re-registering an existing name updates its program, model and task.

project_key.description: Absolute path of the repository's primary checkout.

tools.name: macro_start_session
tools.description: Start a session in one call: ensure the project, register the agent, optionally reserve paths, and return the latest inbox without marking it read.

human_key.description: Absolute path of the repository's primary checkout.

inbox_limit.description: Positive page size; default 10, capped at 1000.

project_key.description: Absolute path of the repository's primary checkout.

tools.name: list_agents
tools.description: List a project's agents that are not retired, most recently active first.

project_key.description: Absolute path of the repository's primary checkout.

limit.description: Positive page size; default 250, capped at 1000.

tools.name: retire_agent
tools.description: Retire an agent so it no longer appears in list_agents.

project_key.description: Absolute path of the repository's primary checkout.
Absolute path of the repository's primary checkout.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a Markdown message to agents in the same project. Unknown recipients fail the whole send. Returns the message, including its id. An idempotency_key makes a retry return the first result instead of sending twice.

project_key.description: Absolute path of the repository's primary checkout.

tools.name: reply_message
tools.description: Reply in a message's thread. Defaults: to the original sender, the original's topic, importance and ack_required, and a 'Re:' subject. Returns the message with reply_to.

project_key.description: Absolute path of the repository's primary checkout.

tools.name: fetch_inbox
tools.description: Return your latest messages, newest first, and mark them read unless mark_read is false.

project_key.description: Absolute path of the repository's primary checkout.

limit.description: Positive page size; default 20, capped at 1000.

ack_overdue_only.description: Only unacknowledged ack_required messages older than 30 minutes.

tools.name: mark_message_read
tools.description: Mark one message read for you.

project_key.description: Absolute path of the repository's primary checkout.

tools.name: acknowledge_message
tools.description: Acknowledge one message (also marks it read).

project_key.description: Absolute path of the repository's primary checkout.

tools.name: get_message_delivery_receipt
tools.description: Show, per recipient, whether a message was read and acknowledged.

project_key.description: Absolute path of the repository's primary checkout.

tools.name: search_messages
tools.description: Full-text search over subjects and bodies in a project, best match first (ranking: 'recency' for newest first). Results include an excerpt of up to 512 Unicode code points from the best matching subject or body, with >>>matched text<<< markers. Pass next_cursor back as cursor for the next page.

project_key.description: Absolute path of the repository's primary checkout.

limit.description: Positive page size; default 20, capped at 1000.

tools.name: summarize_thread
tools.description: Return a thread's participants and messages, oldest first, for you to summarize.

project_key.description: Absolute path of the repository's primary checkout.

thread_id.description: The first message's id, or the thread_id its replies carry.

per_thread_limit.description: Newest messages to return; positive page size, default 50, capped at 1000.

tools.name: file_reservation_paths
tools.description: Advisory reservation of paths or globs so other agents know what you are editing. Paths another agent holds come back as conflicts, not grants.

project_key.description: Absolute path of the repository's primary checkout.

tools.name: renew_file_reservations
tools.description: Extend your active reservations, all or those matching paths or ids.

project_key.description: Absolute path of the repository's primary checkout.

tools.name: release_file_reservations
tools.description: Release your active reservations, all or those matching paths or ids.

project_key.description: Absolute path of the repository's primary checkout.
